g.text: CSR stores repeated weights and indices at each valid output location.
Operator storage grows even when the trained kernel stays small.

g.text: Direct CUDA keeps the original weight tensor.
Tiled CUDA adds a temporary shared-memory patch per block.
Storage is calculated from tensor values and indices, not peak process memory.
Activations, allocator caches and backend workspaces are excluded.
